scope: Local dataflow replacement: materialized E5M2 native dot -> two scales -> F32 H reduction in a single Main stream. Not a whole FFN redesign.
source_components: E127 complete kernel and M03 cluster-local ownership
E73 scale-resident fusion idea; no repeated FP8-to-BF16 lookup
prior_related: E73 measured +10.24% with repeated BF16 lookup
C11 static +3.55%, no NPU; partial-to-VRF handoff and 30 native starts
E127 native materialization with separate DM partials
full_graph: preRMS -> actual3termE5 preparation/broadcast -> compactFP4HBM/DM -> fullE5M2DM -> perprojection xTRF/xscaleVRF reload -> 5 sixrow nativeDPE/Mul0xscale/Mul1blockscale/F32Hreduce streams -> existing F32 local compact/BF16 -> M03 GeGLU/down -> F32cluster sum -> unchanged epilogue

placement.weight: Existing compact FP4 HBM/DM and full E5M2 DM, each cluster owns L half
placement.activation: Existing 3termE5 TRF plus 32B xscale VRF, reloaded per projection
placement.block_scale: FP8 DM -> Sub F32 VRF, six rows x240x4 =5760B per slice
placement.partial: No block partial tensor in DM/VRF; F32 stream through two MULs and H reduce
placement.output: F32 Row30 DM destination via disjoint sixrow tiles, paired 8B commits; existing BF16 cast after120row local gather

costs.added_risks: Smaller dot setup, scale-ready dependency, shared VE occupancy and two VRF operand indexing

first_gate: Compile exact full FFN; prove partial DM/VRF absence and 10 fused native streams, actual weight/scale/output coverage. Repair understood API/layout bugs with frozen attempts, no arbitrary tile sweep.
correctness_gate: Actual quantizer, distinct up/gate block scales, sixrow/cluster/block boundaries and cancellation/zero; standard whole FFN before performance claim.

decisions.adoption: Unvalidated; positive screen proceeds to bounded independent repeats and expanded correctness even below5%.
decisions.further_tuning: No tile sweep; fixed sixrow scale mapping.5% only limits further tuning, not adoption.
decisions.major_research: Test partial storage removal; projection-cluster ownership for weight materialization remains separate larger research.
